title: Module catalogue of a profile (profiles/<name>/modules.json)
description: Optional. Names you use for modules, mapped to their code path and to the words that find their Jira stories. When a module is listed here, the scout uses these settings instead of guessing.

modules.description: Key = the name you type, e.g. "import job" (case-insensitive).

path.description: Code module path under the frontend root, e.g. admin/import-job (see: node scripts/modules.mjs).

codePaths.description: Repo-relative folders or files that are this module's own code, read in addition to <frontendRoot>/<path>. Use for shared features that live outside the feature folders (e.g. the grid export service). With codePaths, <path> may be a name that has no folder.

crossCutting.description: A feature used on many pages (e.g. grid export). Stories whose QA doc belongs to another page are kept when they mention a keyword, and only the use cases of that doc that mention a keyword are analysed.

focusPattern.description: Cross-cutting modules: regex (case-insensitive) for the feature's core term, e.g. "\\bexport". Another page's UC is kept whole when its title matches, narrowed to the matching steps/flows otherwise; that page's free-text scenarios are kept only when they match. Default: the word most keywords share.

aliases.description: Other names that should pick this module, e.g. "bundle import".

keywords.description: Words that Jira stories about this module contain. Used for the Jira search and to assign stories to the module. Avoid words that also name customers/projects.

zephyrFolder.description: Folder path (or part of it) where new test cases for this module belong, e.g. "Bundle Import".

includeStories.description: Stories that always belong to the module, even without a keyword hit.

excludeStories.description: Stories never analysed for this module (noise).

jql.description: Optional full JQL that replaces the keyword search.

uiRoutes.description: Paths of the module's screens relative to the environment's uiBaseUrl (e.g. "/admin/import-job"). Without them the ui-explorer finds the route in the frontend code.

notes.description: Anything the agents should know about this module.
